maria (PM): Quick convowe need a narrower path to ship the pilot this quarter. Proposal: split the milestone into Phase 1 (pilot-ready) and Phase 2 (full v1).
maria (PM): Phase 1 = stable core gen, tenant auth, basic telemetry, pilot UI flow. Phase 2 = reranker, full KV cache, model routing, advanced metrics.
drew (Eng): Agree splitting helps. Main constraint: reranker and metrics are interdependent for quality signoff. If we push reranker to Phase 2 we need conservative rollout knobs.
alex (Eng-Platform): We can add a rollout flag + traffic-slice. Platform work to support canary slices is ~4d. Need to prioritize dashboard metrics (p50/p95 + correctness signals).
lisa (Sales): Pilot customer (Northpeak) insists on <350ms p95 and deterministic top-k. If we deliver Phase 1 without reranker they might not sign. Can we do a lightweight ranking shim?
drew (Eng): Lightweight shim (keyword boost + short scorer) is doable in 7-10 dev days and can live behind the flag. Full reranker stays Phase 2 with dedicated evals.
tyler (Design): For pilot UX we can hide advanced ranking controls and expose only a toggle. Keeps the product simple and reduces support load.
maria (PM): So plan B: Phase 1 ships with a ranking shim + opt-in cache (no compaction), Phase 2 adds full reranker + compaction + routing.
ellen (Analytics): We'll need a quality gate: A/B on top-100 customer prompts, quality delta v baseline <= 8%. I can run synthetic evals during canary.
drew (Eng): Timeline impact: shim + flag + basic telemetry = 2 sprints if we parallelize. Full reranker = sprint+2. Risk: corner cases in ordering under high prefix overlap.
alex (Eng-Platform): Canary config (we can automate):
```
# release plan snippet
release create mar-pilot --phase=1
canary set mar-pilot --percent=1 --metric=p95_latency
canary promote mar-pilot --percent=10 --metric=quality_score
```

alex (Eng-Platform): We'll also emit ranking-quality metric from eval job. ETA for infra + dashboards: 5 working days if deprioritized tasks are pushed.
maria (PM): Acceptance criteria for Phase 1 (draft):
- Core generation meets pilot p95 < 350ms on pilot prompts
- Auth + telemetry enabled for pilot orgs
- Ranking shim validated with quality delta <= 8% on seed set
- Feature flag + canary + rollback path in place
- UX toggle present for pilot users
lisa (Sales): I'll commit to telling Northpeak that Phase 1 is pilot-ready with ranking shim and opt-in cache; Phase 2 will follow ~4 weeks after pilot start. They'll want exact dates.
ellen (Analytics): I'll run the seed set today and share a short report by EOD. If the shim fails quality gate I'll flag for decision.
drew (Eng): Need PM signoff to deprioritize small perf cleanup tasks this sprint so we can focus on shim + flags.
maria (PM): Approved. We'll deprioritize non-critical perf chores. Sam, please add Phase 1 / Phase 2 tickets to the roadmap and link to canary checklist.
release-bot: Created release branch: release/mar-pilot (2348800005)
release-bot: Canary job scheduled: canary-job-2348800010
ellen (Analytics): Ran eval: initial quality delta 6.2% (top-100). P95 latency for seeded prompts = 340ms. Passes gates so far.
lisa (Sales): Great. I'll propose pilot kickoff window 3/24 - 3/26 to Northpeak. Will confirm after we land canary.
maria (PM): Nice. Action items: (1) Drew/Alex finish shim + flag (2) Ellen final eval + dashboard (3) Lisa confirm pilot dates (4) Product Ops add canary steps. Ping here if anything blocks.
